name: Block

examples.title: Spacing and Alignment
examples.code:
<Block m="4" p="4" textAlign="centered">
  Block with Margin, Padding, and Centered Text
</Block>

examples.title: Viewport-Specific Text Color
examples.code:
<Block textColor="primary" viewport="tablet">
  Block with Tablet-specific Primary Text
</Block>

examples.title: Interactive Block with Multiple Props
examples.code:
<Block textColor="success" bgColor="dark" m="3" p="3" textAlign="right">
  Interactive Block
</Block>

examples.title: Stacked Blocks (Demonstrating Vertical Spacing)
examples.code:
<Block display="flex" flexDirection="column" gap="0">
  <Block>
    <Notification color="primary" mb={0}>
      First Block
    </Notification>
  </Block>
  <Block>
    <Notification color="info" mb={0}>
      Second Block
    </Notification>
  </Block>
  <Block>
    <Notification color="success" mb={0}>
      Third Block
    </Notification>
  </Block>
  <Block>
    <Notification color="warning" mb={0}>
      Fourth Block
    </Notification>
  </Block>
</Block>

accessibility:
- **Content:** Use semantic HTML inside `Block` for best accessibility.
- **Spacing:** The `.block` class is for layout only and does not affect accessibility.
- **Contrast:** Choose text and background colors for good readability.

:::info
Use `Block` for logical, visually separated sections of content.
:::
summary: The `Block` component renders a simple container with Bulma's `.block` class, adding vertical margin between sections of content.

parts.summary: The `Block` component renders a simple container with Bulma's `.block` class, adding vertical margin between sections of content.

props.name: color
props.description: Text color alias: renders `has-text-<color>`, exactly like `textColor`. Not a filled variant (no `.block.is-<color>` CSS exists). Prefer `textColor`, which takes precedence when both are set; use `bgColor` for a colored surface.

props.name: children
props.description: Content to render inside the block.

parts.catchAll: All standard <div> attributes and Bulma helper props
